output.review_comment:
The code makes all tests pass, but it implements volume pricing (all units charged at the last tier's price when quantity reaches that tier) which directly contradicts the docstring's guarantee that "Reaching a higher tier never changes the price of the units in the lower tiers."

Since the tests encode the correct spec, the implementation is right, but the docstring must be updated to reflect the volume pricing behavior when the last open-ended tier is reached. Without this, future maintainers will be misled about the actual pricing logic.

Please update the docstring to accurately describe the volume pricing behavior for orders reaching the final tier.
